title: 第5章 废墟里的变异兽第6章 第一个伙伴
lines: 荒野静得吓人，这种死寂往往意味着危险就要来了。
灰压压的云堆在天边，旷野里一丝风都没有。飘浮的辐射尘像定格了一样，空气稠得跟凝固的血块似的，闷得人喘不过气。方圆千米之内，一点活物的动静都没了，连最耐活的辐射虫子都不见踪影。只有碎石头、干裂的泥土和倒塌的墙，铺开成一片死气沉沉的囚笼。
陆寻放低重心，全身的肌肉都绷紧了。
左腿旧伤一阵阵发酸发胀，一用力就扯着受伤的地方，细密的疼顺着骨头缝往全身钻，时刻提醒着他这条腿不行。他没法冲刺，也没法快速躲闪，万一打起来，周旋、防守、逃命，全都得靠精准的判断和一步不差的走位。
这是在废土拖着一条残腿活下来的本能，也是他十几年来拼杀练出的唯一依靠。
他没往前冲，也没往后退。在废土荒野，进退都可能要命——胡乱闯进未知区域是送死，临阵逃跑把后背露出来更是死路一条。他微微侧过身，把林小满严严实实挡在身后，宽厚的背脊对着前方所有看不见的危险。短刀横在身前，刀刃朝外，手指死死攥着刀柄，攥得指节都白了。
“锁定范围。”陆寻低声说，声音压得极轻，融进这片死寂里，没多发出一点声响。
林小满呼吸放得很缓，精神感知像一张看不见的网，细细地铺向前方的盲区，不放过任何一丝震动或气息。她身体微微绷着，却没有慌——早就习惯了这种命悬一线的对峙。
她没有战斗力，拿不了刀对抗敌人，却是陆寻在绝境里唯一的眼睛。
“八百米，低洼废墟带。”林小满语速很快，每个字都清晰准确，没半句废话，“地底下有密集的低频震动，不是零散的活物，是成群分布的，至少七头以上。体温很低，代谢混乱，是深度辐射变异体。”
她话音刚落，地面就轻轻震了一下。
不是地震那种轰隆声，是密集、轻巧、很有规律的踩踏声，从地底废墟的夹层里传出来，一层叠一层，越来越近。石头缝里沙沙掉灰，干裂的地面裂开细纹，一股又腥又臊、混着辐射腐臭的气味，从地缝里涌出来，一下子冲散了空气中沉闷的土味。
是变异沙狼。
白峰城外荒野最常见的成群掠食者，常年泡在高浓度辐射里，身体畸形，性子暴烈，咬合力能轻松嚼碎钢筋骨头，从来成群行动，不会落单。刚才这片地方死气沉沉的，根本不是没活物，而是狼群藏着气息、等着猎物送上门来的狩猎场。
下一秒，废墟堆轰地炸开。
三头畸形的沙狼率先从地底夹层窜出来，身子比普通野狼壮了近一倍，皮毛大片脱落，露出的皮肉是一种诡异的暗红色，血管狰狞地凸起，盘在骨架上。四肢关节扭曲变形，这是辐射畸变留下的痕迹，却一点没影响它们奔跑的速度。利爪刨过碎石，带出一串火星，猩红的眼睛死死盯住前面的活人，野性的杀意瞬间炸开。
没有试探，没有吼叫蓄力。
废土变异兽的狩猎，永远直接扑杀。
三头沙狼摆成三角阵型，压低身体，贴地疾冲，獠牙外露，口水滴下来，把地上的石头都腐蚀得微微冒烟。速度极快，带起凌厉的风，眨眼就逼近百米之内，死亡的阴影瞬间罩在两人头顶。
“左边最快！右边有埋伏！后面还有包抄的！”林小满感知全开，瞬间捕捉到所有动静，声音又冷又急，精准报出每一处危险，“它们在封你的躲闪路线！”
陆寻眼里没有一点慌乱。
恐惧是弱者的情绪，在废土挣扎十六年，他早就戒掉了没用的害怕。脑子里瞬间铺开整片地形——断墙、沟壑、碎石堆的位置清晰浮现，结合林小满的预警，不到半秒就找到了唯一的生路。
他不能跑。
左腿的伤注定他跑不过变异沙狼，一旦转身逃，后背暴露，瞬间就会被狼群撕碎。
只能硬扛。
“贴紧我，别乱动。”
陆寻沉声交代一句，脚步猛地横移，精准地把林小满护到身后断墙的死角，让墙体彻底挡住她，避免被波及。
同一时间，他主动迎上扑来的第一头沙狼。
风声刺耳，兽影狰狞。
那头带头的沙狼腾空扑杀，庞大的身子带着千斤力道，利爪撕开空气，直冲陆寻喉咙而来，是最凶狠的搏命招式。
陆寻不躲不闪，沉腰、压刀、发力。
他把所有重心压在完好的右腿上，左腿轻轻点地支撑，避免旧伤撕裂，手中短刀顺着狼扑的势头，精准地斜撩上去。没有花哨招式，没有多余动作，只有十几年拾荒搏杀练出的极致精准——刀刃死死咬进沙狼脖颈最脆弱的软甲缝隙。
精铁割开腐肉的短促锐响。
锋利的合金刀直接划开畸变的狼皮，切进颈侧大动脉。墨绿色的污血喷出来，带着浓烈的辐射腥臭味，溅在碎石上，立刻腐蚀出点点灰白的坑。
腾空扑杀的沙狼身子一僵，凶悍的扑击力道瞬间散了，庞大的躯体重重砸在地上，四肢剧烈抽搐几下，猩红的眼珠迅速暗淡，没了气息。
一击毙命。
没半点拖泥带水，这是废土生死厮杀的唯一准则——出手就要致命，绝不给对手反扑的机会。
可另外两头沙狼一点没怕。
辐射畸变的野兽早就没了生灵的恐惧心，只剩下嗜血的本能。同伴的死只会刺激它们的凶性，两头恶狼同时加速，一左一右钳形包抄，利爪贴地刮过碎石，发出密集刺耳的摩擦声，死死封住陆寻左右所有躲闪的空间。
同时，林小满急促的预警再次响起：“后面两头到位了！地底还有两头没出来，在等着偷袭！”
五处杀机，层层合围。
真正的死局，瞬间成型。
陆寻落地站稳，左腿猛地受力，旧伤像被撕开一样刺痛，尖锐的痛感从腰腹蔓延到全身，额头立刻冒出一层细汗。肌肉的酸胀、骨头的钝痛、伤口的撕裂感一层层叠上来，几乎要拖垮他的身子。
他咬紧牙关，压下所有痛感，绝不允许自己在厮杀中露出半点破绽。
content_en:
The wilderness is eerily quiet, and this dead silence often means danger is coming.
Gray clouds piled in the sky, and there was no wind in the wilderness. The floating radiation dust seemed to be frozen, and the air was as thick as coagulated blood, making people breathless. Within a radius of a kilometer, there was no movement of any living creature, not even the most resistant radiation bugs. Only broken stones, cracked soil and collapsed walls spread out into a lifeless cage.
Lu Xun lowered his center of gravity, and all the muscles in his body tensed.
The old injury on his left leg was sore and swollen. Every time he exerted force, he would pull at the injured area. Fine pains would penetrate the whole body along the seams of the bones, always reminding him that this leg was not good. He couldn't sprint or dodge quickly. If a fight broke out, maneuvering, defending, and escaping all depended on accurate judgment and precise positioning.
This was the instinct to survive dragging a broken leg in the wasteland, and it was also the only thing he relied on for more than ten years of hard work.
He didn't rush forward, nor did he retreat. In the wasteland, advancing or retreating can be fatal - rushing into an unknown area will lead to death, and running away in the middle of the battle and exposing your back will be a dead end. He turned slightly to the side, blocking Lin Xiaoman tightly behind him, his broad back facing all the invisible dangers ahead. The short knife was lying in front of him, with the blade facing outward. His fingers were tightly gripping the handle of the knife, so tightly that his knuckles turned white.
"Lock the range." Lu Xun whispered, his voice was very soft, blending into the dead silence without making any more noise.
Lin Xiaoman breathed very slowly, and his mental perception was like an invisible net, spreading thinly to the blind spot in front, not letting go of any vibration or breath. Her body was slightly tense, but she didn't panic - she had long been used to this kind of confrontation where her life was hanging by a thread.
She has no fighting ability and cannot hold a knife to fight against the enemy, but she is Lu Xun's only eye in a desperate situation.
"Eight hundred meters, low-lying ruins area." Lin Xiaoman spoke very quickly, every word was clear and accurate, and there was no nonsense. "There are dense low-frequency vibrations underground. They are not scattered living creatures, but distributed in groups, at least seven or more. The body temperature is very low, the metabolism is chaotic, and it is a deep radiation mutation."
As soon as she finished speaking, the ground shook slightly.
It was not the rumbling sound of an earthquake, but a dense, light, and regular sound of stampeding, coming from the interlayers of the underground ruins, one layer after another, getting closer and closer. Dust fell from the cracks in the stones, fine lines appeared on the cracked ground, and a fishy and smelly smell, mixed with the rotten smell of radiation, came out from the cracks in the ground, suddenly dispersing the dull earthy smell in the air.
It's a mutant sand wolf.
The most common group of predators in the wilderness outside Baifeng City. They have been soaked in high concentrations of radiation all year round. They have deformed bodies, violent tempers, and a bite force that can easily chew steel bones. They always move in groups and will never be alone. This place was lifeless just now. It wasn't that there were no living creatures at all, but it was a hunting ground where wolves were hiding their auras and waiting for their prey to come to them.
The next second, the pile of rubble exploded.
The three-headed sand wolf was the first to emerge from the underground mezzanine. Its body was nearly twice as strong as that of an ordinary wild wolf. Large areas of its fur fell off, and the exposed flesh was a strange dark red color. The blood vessels protruded ferociously and were coiled around the skeleton. The joints of the limbs were twisted and deformed, which were traces left by radiation distortion, but it did not affect their running speed at all. The sharp claws scraped through the gravel, bringing out a string of sparks. The scarlet eyes stared at the living person in front, and the wild killing intent exploded instantly.
No probing, no roaring charges.
The hunting of mutant beasts in the wasteland will always be directly culled.
The three sand wolves formed a triangular formation, lowered their bodies, and sprinted close to the ground. Their fangs were exposed, and their saliva dripped down, corroding the stones on the ground until they were smoking slightly. The speed was extremely fast, bringing with it a fierce wind, and they were within a hundred meters in the blink of an eye. The shadow of death instantly fell over the two of them.
"The left side is the fastest! There is an ambush on the right side! There are people outflanking you from behind!" Lin Xiaoman's senses were fully activated, and he caught all the movements instantly. His voice was cold and urgent, and he accurately reported every danger, "They are blocking your dodge route!"
There was no trace of panic in Lu Xun's eyes.
Fear is the emotion of the weak. After struggling in the wasteland for sixteen years, he had long since given up on useless fear. The entire terrain was instantly spread out in his mind - the locations of broken walls, ravines, and piles of rubble appeared clearly. Combined with Lin Xiaoman's warning, he found the only way out in less than half a second.
He can't run.
The injury to his left leg meant that he would not be able to outrun the mutated sand wolf. Once he turned around and fled, his back would be exposed and he would be torn apart by the wolves in an instant.
You can only carry it hard.
"Stick close to me and don't move."
Lu Xun confessed in a deep voice, then moved his steps suddenly, accurately protecting Lin Xiaoman to the blind corner of the broken wall behind her, so that the wall completely blocked her to avoid being affected.
At the same time, he took the initiative to meet the first sand wolf that rushed towards him.
The wind is harsh and the shadows of beasts are ferocious.
The leading sand wolf flew into the air to attack, its huge body carrying a thousand pounds of strength, its claws tore through the air, and headed straight for Lu Xun's throat. It was the most ferocious and life-threatening move.
Lu Xun did not dodge or dodge, he lowered his waist, pressed the knife, and exerted his strength.
He put all his weight on his intact right leg and gently supported his left leg to prevent the old injury from tearing. He followed the momentum of the wolf's pounce with the short knife in his hand and accurately raised it diagonally. There are no fancy moves, no superfluous movements, just the ultimate precision honed by more than ten years of scavenging and fighting - the blade bites into the most vulnerable soft armor gap in the sand wolf's neck.
Chi——
The sharp sound of fine iron cutting through carrion.
The sharp alloy knife directly cut through the distorted wolf skin and cut into the main artery on the side of the neck. Dark green blood spurted out, carrying a strong stench of radiation, and splashed on the gravel, immediately corroding into gray pits.
The body of the sand wolf that jumped into the air to attack him froze, and the force of its ferocious attack instantly dissipated. Its huge body hit the ground heavily, its limbs twitched violently several times, its scarlet eyes quickly dimmed, and it lost its breath.
Kill with one blow.
There is no sloppiness at all, this is the only rule of life and death fighting in the wasteland - be fatal when you take action, and never give your opponent a chance to counterattack.
But the other two sand wolves were not afraid at all.
The radiation-distorted beasts have long since lost all fear of living beings, leaving only their bloodthirsty instincts. The death of their companions only stimulated their ferocity. The two evil wolves accelerated at the same time, one on the left and the other in a pincer-like manner. Their sharp claws scraped against the gravel, making a dense and harsh friction sound, sealing off all space for Lu Xun to dodge.
At the same time, Lin Xiaoman's urgent warning sounded again: "The two ends at the back are in place! There are still two ends under the ground that have not come out, waiting for a sneak attack!"
Five murderous intentions, surrounded layer by layer.
The real dead end took shape in an instant.
Lu Xun landed and stood firm, his left leg suddenly felt force, and the old wound stung as if it had been torn open. The sharp pain spread from his waist and abdomen to his whole body, and a thin layer of sweat immediately broke out on his forehead. The soreness of muscles, the dull pain of bones, and the tearing sensation of wounds piled up one after another, almost weighing down his body.
He gritted his teeth, suppressed all the pain, and never allowed himself to show any flaws in the fight.
title_en: Chapter 5 Mutated Beasts in the Ruins Chapter 6 The First Partner
